name: Sokoban Warehouse
shortDescription: Classic box-pushing puzzle game with 12 levels of increasing difficulty. Push crates onto targets using swipe, on-screen D-pad, or arrow keys — with unlimited undo, level select, and a built-in level builder with shareable links.

suggestion.prompt: Build a mobile-first version of the classic puzzle game Sokoban with multiple levels. The game should run in a single web page, no frameworks. Requirements: Grid-based warehouse layout with walls, floor tiles, movable boxes/crates, storage targets, and a player. Use simple 2D graphics or colored tiles; ensure everything is readable on phones. Touch controls for mobile (swipe or on-screen arrows) and arrow keys for desktop. Rules: the player can move up/down/left/right; pushing exactly one adjacent box into an empty floor tile is allowed, but pulling is not. Level is solved when all boxes are on target tiles. Include at least 10 built-in levels of increasing difficulty, selectable from a simple level menu. Track moves and pushes; show level complete message and option to restart or go to the next level. Provide a clean, responsive layout that works well on small screens first, then scales to desktop.

improvements.description: Reworked upper-level Sokoban layouts to ensure the reported levels are solvable.
Added solvability validator: checks crate/target counts, BFS reachability from player, and dead-corner detection; shows a warning banner when structural issues are detected on level load.
When a level is successfully completed, made the "Next Level" button the default action when the user presses the Return/Enter key.
Added level builder where users can design custom levels with a tile palette, validate solvability, prove solvability by test-playing, generate shareable links, and export level data to console.
Added a clipboard icon button next to the generated Level Builder share link so users can copy it on demand.
Updated the level builder so placing player/crate on targets (and targets under player/crate) preserves combined on-target tiles.
Added a clear on-target badge indicator in the level builder when a player or crate is placed on a target tile.

generation.notes: Built from approved community suggestion issue #230. 12 hand-crafted levels of increasing difficulty. Canvas-based rendering with brick walls, wooden crate aesthetic, amber color palette. Token counts are estimates.
